question: Sorry for showing up late ;_; When she was a child, what kind of child was Elsa?
answer: She was born in Gusteko to a poor family, so she ran away before she was sold, stole, deceived men and back-stabbed them, and made it through life that way. In the cold, when she was caught stealing and opened the belly of the one who caught her, she awoke to "Bowel Hunting", was caught after piling up slaughters, and was sold as a slave to an evil shaman.
